csv_scope_of_work: Project: Exposition Park Utility Replacement and Site Improvements Location: 700 Exposition Park Drive, Los Angeles, California The Department of General Services (DGS) performed a comprehensive infrastructure assessment of Exposition Park in May 2025 to identify existing conditions and necessary site improvements, detailing necessary maintenance to roadways, sidewalks, electrical infrastructure, lighting, and drainage systems. title: Design-Build for Exposition Park Utility Replacement
short_description: Design-build utility and site infrastructure upgrades at Exposition Park in Los Angeles.
project_location: 700 Exposition Park Drive, Los Angeles, California, USA
project_scope: Utility replacement and site improvements at Exposition Park based on a 2025 infrastructure assessment. The identified works include maintenance and upgrades to roadways, sidewalks, electrical infrastructure, lighting, and drainage systems, plus other prioritized deferred maintenance measures required for public safety and continued operation of existing state property and park infrastructure. Total stated construction cost is 76.0 million.
services: Design-build / developer services for utility replacement and site improvements.
relevance_explanation:
- Primarily a utility replacement and site infrastructure project, not a bridge, long-span roof, special structure, or complex building.
- Scope focuses on roadways, sidewalks, electrical infrastructure, lighting, and drainage rather than structural engineering of sbp core interest.
- Procurement is design-build, which can be strategically relevant, but no explicit structural design component for complex load-bearing structures is described.
- Park infrastructure and deferred maintenance works are generally low relevance for sbp.
construction_cost_explanation: Taken from the tender documents: Total Construction Cost: $76.0M.
fee_explanation: No explicit planning or engineering fee stated in the source. The notice only provides total construction cost and identifies the procurement as design-build.
references_qualifications: Mandatory pre-submittal meeting. Contract participation goals: SBE 25% and DVBE 3%. Prevailing wage rates may apply. No specific technical reference requirements are stated in the provided source.
